entity_types: Stichting (privaat nut) — Dutch-style foundation by notarial deed under the Stichtingenwet of 19 July 1968; also vereniging (association) and coöperatie.
cost_time: Official fees unpublished (as of 2026); register fees set by staatsbesluit (Besluit Stichtingenregister G.B. 1970 no. 126, as amended). KKF excerpt SRD 300. Notary ~US$200–500, total ~US$500–1,500; 1–3 months (unofficial estimates).
foreign_no_presence: partial — Stichtingenwet 1968 has no nationality/residence requirement for founder or board, and the seat is the place designated in the articles; but creation requires a notarial deed by a Surinamese notary, so a remote founder needs a notarized power of attorney; banking and practice favor local presence.
